channel.title: Scooby-Doo and the Cyber Chase
channel.desc: When Scooby, Shaggy and their friends try to capture the Phantom Virus, they accidentally become transported into a video game based on their own Mystery Inc adventures. While pursuing the dastardly virus through the game's ten outrageous levels, the crimefighters travel from the prehistoric past to the space-age future, and even tangle with a hair-raising horde of virtual villains from their most famous capers.
